name: galaxie
description: A browser-first agent runtime SDK for web apps.

scripts.check: pnpm run check:license && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:ts6 && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/core/test && tsc -p scripts
scripts.typecheck:ts6: tsc6 -p packages/core && tsc6 -p packages/core/test && tsc6 -p scripts
